At the standalone level, we delivered 17% Y-o-Y growth in revenue, reaching INR156 crores in Q1 FY27, compared to INR134 crores in Q1 FY26. As of August 8, our standalone order book stood at INR1,224 crores, while our consolidated order book stood at INR1,704 crores, which includes an order book of INR480 crores at Ideal Explosives Limited, reflecting a healthy and robust orders across the group.
